programme.title: Dr. Savannah: Wild Rose Vet - Feels Like Home

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal - Sammi, Rose, and Casey

programme.title: Wild Rose Vet - Old Dogs, New Tricks

programme.title: Wild Science - Lion
programme.desc: S1E1 - Tracing the lion's rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter; getting swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts. - Nil

programme.title: Wild Science - Bull Shark
programme.desc: S1E2 - Confront the ocean's most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. - Nil

programme.title: Wild Science - Brown Bear
programme.desc: S1E3 - Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to today's modern omnivores; witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in. - Nil (Science, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Wild Science - Black Rhino
programme.desc: S1E4 - Following the journey of the black rhino and seeing how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature; experiencing this armoured herbivore's extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages. - Nil (Nature)

programme.title: Wild Science - Hippo
programme.desc: S1E5 - Looking inside the life of one of Africa's most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus; getting in the middle of a sparring match and seeing just how deadly a territorial male's bite can be, then witnessing the miracle of their underwater births. - Nil (Animals)

programme.title: Wild Science - Caiman
programme.desc: S1E6 - Understanding how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world; watching butterflies feed on their tears, then marvelling at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries. - Nil (Animals)

Only one man is willing to take that risk: Harry Svensson, who runs the top family law practice in the city. He also happens to be Abby's estranged father, who left Abby and her complicated mother for his secretary when Abby was seven. Thus begins the odd dynamic at Abigail's new workplace. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie)

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protege (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. - Pierce Brosnan, Luke Bracey, Olga Kurylenko, Bill Smitrovich, Amila Terzimehić (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Mel Gibson, Demián Bichir (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Gloria is an out-of-work party girl who leaves New York and moves back to her hometown after getting kicked out of her apartment by her boyfriend. When news reports surface that a giant creature is destroying Seoul, South Korea, Gloria gradually comes to the realization that she is somehow connected to this far-off phenomenon. As events begin to spiral out of control, she must figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. - Anne Hathaway, Jason Sudeikis, Austin Stowell, Tim Blake Nelson, Dan Stevens (Comedy drama, Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 7
programme.desc: S1E7 - A desperate couple hold a truck driver hostage in his own semi; marine patrol deputies chase down smugglers in a high-speed boat chase; officers report a late-night pursuit of a suspect fleeing in reverse.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 15
programme.desc: S2E15 - After a long, high-speed chase, deputies discover a one-year-old girl in the back of the suspect's car; a Good Samaritan gives an out-of-breath officer a ride in his car to make up some ground during a foot pursuit.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 18
programme.desc: S1E18 - Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; a woman accused of shoplifting rams a police cruiser and leads officers on a dangerous high speed chase.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 9
programme.desc: S2E9 - Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; a man fleeing from state troopers jumps off Florida's 7-Mile Bridge into the ocean below; a wanted man smashes into multiple cars while trying to flee from police at a gas station.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 17
programme.desc: S1E17 - Police and Highway Patrol pull a shoplifting suspect to safety after he hangs from a highway overpass; deputies, air units and K-9 officers chase down a suspect on foot and in the water.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape - Episode 11
programme.desc: S2E11 - Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; police pursue a man driving his truck recklessly while towing a double-wide mobile home; a woman steals an officer's cruiser and rear-ends an SUV; officers engage in a bicycle pursuit.

programme.title: The First 48 - For a Friend & the Last Gamble
programme.desc: S19E26 - In Atlanta, a teenager is killed when he steps in front of a gunman to save his friend; in Tulsa, Okla., a man is shot dead and left in a church parking lot when he tries to sell a stolen car.

programme.title: The First 48 - Rise Up; Somebody's Friend
programme.desc: S20E8 - In Atlanta, a woman is found dead in a garbage can, and a young man is ambushed by neighborhood bullies.

programme.title: The First 48 - Taken
programme.desc: S21E2 - When a young man and his pregnant fiancée are executed after a failed ransom attempt, Atlanta Homicide will stop at nothing to identify the elusive suspect.

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - Fallen Angel
programme.desc: S1E1 - A rookie detective struggles to unravel the mystery of a teenager found naked and shot to death in a city park; the case captures the hearts of the public; when the victim's car is discovered miles away, the mystery deepens.

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - The Dark Staircase
programme.desc: S1E2 - The Fallen Angel investigation takes homicide detectives back to the scene of the crime; as they sweep the city park for evidence, they discover a surveillance camera with vital footage of the victim's car at the time of her murder.

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - The Jealous Kind
programme.desc: S1E3 - After an intense interrogation, a suspect confesses to brutally murdering Misha Moore over $8; DNA results on the Fallen Angel rape kit match the soda bottle bought by the woman seen in surveillance video.

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - Secrets & Lies
programme.desc: S1E4 - New leads emerge in the Fallen Angel case; in the heart of Atlanta's wealthiest neighborhood, a man is brutally beaten and shot to death.

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - Hot Sun, Cold Blood
programme.desc: S1E5 - On the one-year anniversary of Bridget Shiel's brutal murder, Lowe organizes a vigil and canvass to try and generate new leads and give her family some resolution; Detective Zimbrick gets a DNA match on a 16-year-old cold case. (Reality, Crime)

programme.title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta - The Cooler
programme.desc: S1E6 - A DNA hit in the Bridget Shiel murder investigation identifies a compelling new suspect who was recently imprisoned for a double homicide; Benton investigates the death of a young man who was shot and killed while selling water on a hot summer day. (Reality, Crime)

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Virginia Victorian Home
programme.desc: S7E4 - The team travels to Hot Springs, Va., to salvage mantles, cabinets, sinks, and a round window from a late Victorian-style home; Grayson works on her negotiating and picking skills; Mike helps Tay put together a design for a beam to go above his bar. (Reality, Home improvement)

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Wayne Lanes Bowling Alley
programme.desc: S7E6 - The crew members go to Wayne Lanes in Waynesboro, Va., to salvage bowling balls, bowling pins, bowling shoes, and whatever else they can find in the alley; Robert is determined to redeem himself from last season's bowling fiasco. (Reality, Home improvement)

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Return to Ludwig Mansion
programme.desc: S7E7 - The crew members return to the Ludwig mansion in Pennsylvania; they focus on the outside of the house including the roof tiles, windows and boiler room; Tay races to take out the casement windows, while Mike and Ted try to salvage the roof tiles. (Reality, Home improvement)

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs - Victorian Free Classic House
programme.desc: S7E11 - The crew members return to Hot Springs, Va., to salvage a house before it gets demolished; the house has some Eastlake hardware worth salvaging as well as Majorca tile, mantles and pocket doors. (Reality, Home improvement)

programme.title: Barnwood Builders - From Texas to Tennessee: A Look Back
programme.desc: Mark Bowe looks back at season 8 of "Barnwood Builders," which was full of surprises with new faces, new places and a brand-new Boneyard. (Reality, How-to, Home improvement, Documentary)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Cabin Spice
programme.desc: S8E7 - The Wheeler family enlists the help of the team to renovate their old cabin so that it fits their growing kids; the crew removes a dead tree that threatens to fall on the property at any moment. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Revamping the Cook's Beach Camp
programme.desc: S7E12 - The Cabin Masters tackle a cabin and bunkhouse that have been rotting for 30 years on Cook's Beach; With a 12-week timeline and a $50,000 budget for both structures, the team must design on a dime to transform the property by the deadline. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Penobscot Nation Preservation
programme.desc: S8E11 - A Penobscot tribe member summons the team for needed upgrades to her cabin; they have to work fast to beat the start of moose hunting season and to honor the land and Penobscot culture. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Multi-Family Affair
programme.desc: S4E5 - A couple found an isolated cabin and fell in love with idea of owning and restoring it; Chase and the team have their hands full trying to repair and restore this cabin that's only accessible by hiking or by boating across the lake. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Camp Over Troubled Waters
programme.desc: S8E12 - A family finds their camp flooded when they return after winter; as the team pull back what remains of the floor, problems compound as they find powder post beetles, dry rot and more. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Diamond in the Rough

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Philly Couple Renos a South Jersey Shore Vacation Home

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. - Jason Bateman, Olivia Munn, T.J. Miller, Jennifer Aniston, Kate McKinnon (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing, Michael Rooker, Ariana Greenblatt (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Layover
programme.desc: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis. - Alexandra Daddario, Kate Upton, Matt Barr, Matt Jones, Molly Shannon (Comedy)

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop." - David Keith, Drew Barrymore, George C. Scott, Freddie Jones, Heather Locklear (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. - Alex Pettyfer, Vanessa Hudgens, Neil Patrick Harris, Peter Krause, LisaGay Hamilton (Fantasy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death. - Jude Law, Rooney Mara, Channing Tatum, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Vinessa Shaw (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. - Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan, Morgan Freeman, Ed Harris, John Ashton (Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Long ago, Abraham Van Helsing (Christopher Plummer) imprisoned the infamous Count Dracula (Gerard Butler) within a vault inside Carfax Abbey. In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. Liberated from his prison, Dracula seizes the opportunity to escape, but Van Helsing sets out to banish him to the crypt once again. - Christopher Plummer, Gerard Butler, Jonny Lee Miller, Justine Waddell, Jennifer Esposito (Horror, Action, Fantasy, Thriller, Romance)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail. - Jason Scott Lee, Craig Sheffer, Diane Neal, Jason London, Khary Payton (Horror)

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp. - Giorgia Whigham, Corbin Bernsen, Kue Lawrence, Paul Soter, Pierson Fode (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. - Daniel Radcliffe, Misha Handley, Roger Allam, Ciarán Hinds, Janet McTeer (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: 16 Shots
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald. - Anita Alvarez, Dean Angelo, Alma Benitez, Pat Camden, Charlene Carruthers (Documentary)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence. - Deborah Harry, Christian Slater, David Johansen, William Hickey, James Remar (Horror)

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. - Zoe Lister-Jones, Adam Pally, Fred Armisen, Susie Essman, Hannah Simone (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber, Ross Brodar, Josh Charles (Drama)

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. - Jon Hamm, Kyle MacLachlan, Marcia Gay Harden, Roy Wood Jr., Annie Mumolo (Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: Three years after retiring from stripping, Mike Lane (Channing Tatum) reunites with the rest of the Kings of Tampa (Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello) for one final, outrageous performance in Myrtle Beach, S.C.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Ten years after going through traumatic personal crises, three sisters still find it difficult to move on with their lives and find real happiness.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: A journalist (Naomi Watts) investigates the mystery behind a bizarre videotape that brings death after seven days to all who view it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul.

programme.title: Life Below Zero - River of Rage
programme.desc: S8E3 - Alaskans face tremendous obstacles with the spring breakup in full swing. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure)

programme.title: Life Below Zero - Head Above Water

programme.desc: S8E5 - Alaskans race to gather resources while battling challenges from unpredictable weather. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure)

programme.title: Life Below Zero - The Slow Grind

programme.title: Life Below Zero - Midnight Sun

programme.title: Life Below Zero - Howl of the Wild

programme.title: OceanXplorers - Ice Giants

programme.desc: S6E22 - Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Ducks in a Row
programme.desc: S1E5 - Nonnie must figure out how to lead the marching band when a duck gets in its way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Three Guppeteers!
programme.desc: S6E24 - When a Gargoyle steals all the gifts and decorations for Countess Molly's surprise party, the French villagers call in the Three Guppeteers.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Igloo; Clouds; Mr Bull Digs Up the River; Little Swift
programme.desc: It's a snowy day, and Peppa's family build a snowman and an igloo; Mummy, Daddy, Peppa, and George go to the seaside; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George for a day on his boat; Peppa and her family take a sick Swift to the vet.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Long Train Journey; Madame Gazelle's House; Suzy Goes Away; Tiny Land; Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
programme.desc: Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete; Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig go to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Best Friend; Camping; The Playground; The School Fete; Mummy Pig's Birthday
programme.desc: Peppa's friend comes over to play; Peppa and her family go camping; Peppa and George go to the playground; Peppa and her family go to the school fête; the family celebrates Mummy Pig's birthday.

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Super Potato Movie; TV Land; Bird Spotting; The Petting Farm; Goldie the Fish
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends visit the cinema; Peppa finds out how TV is made; Peppa and George go birdwatching; Peppa and friends visit a petting farm; Peppa takes Goldie the fish to visit Dr. Hamster the vet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - All Paws on Deck
programme.desc: S9E16 - Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem; Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
programme.desc: S13E1 - Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap and gets stuck; Mayor Humdinger loses his voice.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Winter Wonderland; The Crew Builds a Giant Snow Squirrely Whirly
programme.desc: S2E21 - Transforming Builder Cove's beach boardwalk into a bright, festive winter wonderland; a snow day gets in the way of Motor and Mix's Super Squirrely Whirly plans.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Sniffle; Pups and the Ghost Cabin
programme.desc: S2E17 - Just as the PAW Patrol is about to help Farmer Al capture his runaway pigs, Chase, Zuma and Skye all become sick; when lunches start disappearing at an old miner's cabin in the woods, the PAW Patrol comes to investigate.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines - Fast Friends
programme.desc: S3E18 - Blaze, AJ, and Gabby meet a brand-new monster machine named Watts - a superfast truck with electric tires; but when one of her special tires goes rolling into the jungle, Blaze, AJ, and Gabby promise to help her get it back.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas - Mother's Day on the High Seas; Bonnie's Bones
programme.desc: S2E25 - It's the Annual Mother's Day Race; Santi hopes to win Josefina the magical prize, but he must contend with Enrique secretly cheating; Bonnie nabs Capitan Calavera's journal to lead her to an amazing treasure.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
programme.desc: S2E22 - Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins
programme.desc: S6E12 - When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups and the Pirate Treasure
programme.desc: S1E26 - Cap'n Turbot stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout; the PAW Patrol searches for clues to find the missing pieces of a treasure map. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Stop a Humdinger Horde; Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Save a Mighty Lighthouse
programme.desc: S7E1 - The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine; Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: DORA - Giant Snowball Adventure; Missing Medals (New)
programme.desc: S5E3 - Dora and Boots save their friends' snowy art before giant snowballs ruin them! Dora and Boots rescue missing medals before Swiper can get to them, saving Sports Day! (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: DORA - Empanada Emergency; Bip Bip's Bug

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Long Grass; Dentist; Nature Trail; Rebecca Rabbit; School Bus Trip

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Stone Age Granny; Space Adventure!; Fire Station Practice; Science Museum; Mr. Bull the Teacher

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Sleepover; Daddy Pig's Office; Pirate Island; George Catches a Cold; Cold Winter's Day
programme.desc: Peppa attends a sleepover; Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office; Granny and Grandpa Pig take everyone on a boat trip; Peppa and George jump in mud puddles; cold day. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Ghost; Pups Save a Show

Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness. - Tim Robbins, Elizabeth Peña, Danny Aiello, Matt Craven, Pruitt Taylor Vince (Horror, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Spell
programme.desc: While flying to his father's funeral in rural Appalachia, an intense storm causes Marquis to lose control of the plane carrying himself and his family. He soon awakens wounded, alone and trapped in Ms. Eloise's attic. Eloise claims she can nurse him back to health with a hoodoo figure she's made from his blood and skin. Unable to call for help, Marquis desperately tries to break free from her dark magic and save his family from a sinister ritual before the rise of the blood moon. - Omari Hardwick, Loretta Devine, John Beasley, Lorraine Burroughs, Hannah Gonera (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. - Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. - Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan, Rhys Darby (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction. - Marlon Brando, Robert Duvall, Martin Sheen, Frederic Forrest, Albert Hall (War, Drama)

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: The Crossing Guard
programme.desc: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future. - Jack Nicholson, David Morse, Anjelica Huston, Robin Wright, Piper Laurie (Drama)

programme.title: Below
programme.desc: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. - Matthew Davis, Bruce Greenwood, Olivia Williams, Holt McCallany, Scott Foley (Thriller)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition. - Vince Vaughn, Christine Taylor, Ben Stiller, Rip Torn, Justin Long (Comedy)

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. - Cate Blanchett, Giovanni Ribisi, Keanu Reeves, Katie Holmes, Greg Kinnear (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin, Sean Bean, Thora Birch (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: An alluring teenage sitter (Alicia Silverstone) becomes the object of her suburban clients' dreams and obsessions.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Tommy Boy

His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. - Chris Farley, David Spade, Brian Dennehy, Bo Derek, Dan Aykroyd (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) diverts the starship Enterprise from its scheduled trip to Cmdr. Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and Counselor Troi's (Marina Sirtis) wedding to negotiate a peace treaty with the Romulans. Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Fantasy)

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Feeling misunderstood at home and at school, mischievous Max (Max Records) escapes to the land of the Wild Things, majestic -- and sometimes fierce -- creatures. They allow Max to become their leader, and he promises to create a kingdom where everyone will be happy. However, Max soon finds that being king is not easy and that, even being with the Wild Things, there is something missing. - Catherine Keener, Max Records, Mark Ruffalo (Children, Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Monster Summer
programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. - Josh Charles, Abigail Spencer, Annie Potts, Josh Segarra, Cree (Comedy drama, Medical)
